note: Written or storytelling register; looks back from a past point.

examples.zh: 他去年搬到了北京，此后就很少回家。
examples.en: He moved to Beijing last year and has rarely come home since.

examples.zh: 他生了一场病，此后每天都锻炼。
examples.en: He had an illness, and has exercised every day since.

examples.zh: 公司三月换了经理，此后一切都变了。
examples.en: The company changed managers in March, and everything changed after that.

note: Typical collocations: 制度健全, 身心健全; as a verb, 健全制度.

examples.zh: 这个城市的管理制度很健全。
examples.en: This city has a very sound management system.

examples.zh: 我们要健全医疗服务，让老人看病更方便。
examples.en: We need to improve medical services so older people can see a doctor more easily.

examples.zh: 孩子的身体和心理都很健全吗？
examples.en: Is the child healthy in both body and mind?

note: In Taiwan and Japan, 研究所 also means graduate school.

examples.zh: 我姐姐在一个研究所工作。
examples.en: My older sister works at a research institute.

examples.zh: 这个研究所研究什么问题？
examples.en: What problems does this research institute study?

examples.zh: 他想毕业以后考研究所。
examples.en: He wants to take the graduate school entrance exam after he graduates.

meaning: B; second party; second in a series

senses.en: B; second party; second in a series

note: In contracts, 甲方 is party A and 乙方 is party B.

examples.zh: 这份合同里，甲方是公司，乙方是我。
examples.en: In this contract, party A is the company and party B is me.

examples.zh: 请在乙方签字的地方写上你的名字。
examples.en: Please write your name where party B signs.

examples.zh: 甲、乙两个方案，你觉得哪个好？
examples.en: Of plans A and B, which do you think is better?

meaning: (formal) to apply to it; to carry out (before a two-syllable verb)

senses.en: (formal) to apply to it; to carry out (before a two-syllable verb)

note: Used before a disyllabic verb: 加以说明, 加以解决. Formal; rarely used in casual talk.

examples.zh: 这些问题要尽快加以解决。
examples.en: These problems need to be solved as soon as possible.

examples.zh: 经理对我们的方案加以说明，大家都同意了。
examples.en: The manager explained our plan and everyone agreed.

examples.zh: 你的想法很好，但还需要加以研究。
examples.en: Your idea is good, but it still needs study.

note: Also means stage presence of a speaker; here only the weather sense.

examples.zh: 明天有台风，飞机可能不能起飞。
examples.en: There is a typhoon tomorrow, so flights may not take off.

examples.zh: 这场台风让很多地方没有电了。
examples.en: This typhoon left many places without power.

examples.zh: 台风来以前，我们买了很多水和吃的。
examples.en: Before the typhoon came, we bought a lot of water and food.

meaning: from time to time; now and then

senses.en: from time to time; now and then

note: Goes before the verb: 不时看手表.

examples.zh: 他不时看手机，好像在等电话。
examples.en: He checks his phone now and then, as if waiting for a call.

examples.zh: 开车时，要不时看看后面。
examples.en: When driving, glance behind you from time to time.

examples.zh: 我们吃饭的时候，外面不时有人笑。
examples.en: While we ate, someone laughed outside every now and then.

note: Colloquial; 游泳池 is the usual word for a swimming pool.

examples.zh: 公园里有一个大池子，里面有很多鱼。
examples.en: There is a big pond in the park with many fish in it.

examples.zh: 这个池子太深，孩子不能进去。
examples.en: This pool is too deep for children to go in.

examples.zh: 这家酒店的池子里，水还是热的吗？
examples.en: Is the water still hot in this hotel pool?

meaning: to hate to part with; to hate to spend or use

senses.en: to hate to part with; to hate to spend or use

note: 舍不得 + noun/verb; the opposite is 舍得. Very common in daily speech.

examples.zh: 我真舍不得离开这里的朋友。
examples.en: I really hate to leave my friends here.

examples.zh: 这件衣服很贵，她舍不得买。
examples.en: This piece of clothing is expensive, so she can't bring herself to buy it.

examples.zh: 你怎么舍不得吃这块蛋糕？
examples.en: Why can't you bear to eat this cake?

note: For large things like roads, bridges, parks; small repairs are 修理.

examples.zh: 政府打算在河上修建一座桥。
examples.en: The government plans to build a bridge over the river.

examples.zh: 这条路是什么时候修建的？
examples.en: When was this road built?

examples.zh: 我们学校旁边要修建一个新公园。
examples.en: A new park will be built next to our school.

note: Used for economy, markets, culture, cities.

examples.zh: 这个城市的经济越来越繁荣。
examples.en: This city's economy is getting more and more prosperous.

examples.zh: 旅游让这个小城市变得很繁荣。
examples.en: Tourism has made this small city very prosperous.

examples.zh: 我们希望国家繁荣，人民幸福。
examples.en: We hope the country prospers and its people are happy.

note: The North Pole is 北极.

examples.zh: 他去年去了南极，看到了很多雪。
examples.en: He went to the South Pole last year and saw lots of snow.

examples.zh: 南极的冬天比北京冷多了。
examples.en: Winter at the South Pole is much colder than in Beijing.

examples.zh: 你想去南极旅游吗？
examples.en: Do you want to travel to the South Pole?

note: Usually 某地/某人 特有的 + noun.

examples.zh: 这是我们家乡特有的一种茶。
examples.en: This is a kind of tea unique to our hometown.

examples.zh: 每个地方都有自己特有的文化。
examples.en: Every place has a culture of its own.

examples.zh: 这种花是中国特有的吗？
examples.en: Is this flower unique to China?

note: For films, books, news: 历史题材, 农村题材.

examples.zh: 他喜欢看历史题材的电影。
examples.en: He likes watching films with historical subjects.

examples.zh: 这本小说的题材很新。
examples.en: The subject matter of this novel is very fresh.

examples.zh: 你想写什么题材的文章？
examples.en: What kind of subject do you want to write about?

note: Opposite: 客观. 太主观 = too subjective / biased.

examples.zh: 你这样想太主观了，要听听别人的意见。
examples.en: You are being too subjective; listen to what others think.

examples.zh: 这只是我的主观看法，不一定对。
examples.en: This is only my subjective view and may not be right.

examples.zh: 医生不能只凭主观感觉做决定。
examples.en: Doctors can't make decisions based only on subjective feelings.

meaning: to be higher than; to exceed

senses.en: to be higher than; to exceed

note: Formal comparison with 于; no 比 needed.

examples.zh: 今年的价格高于去年。
examples.en: This year's price is higher than last year's.

examples.zh: 他的收入高于平均水平。
examples.en: His income is above the average level.

examples.zh: 这里的房子价格高于其他城市。
examples.en: Housing prices here are higher than in other cities.

note: Also 剪刀; 剪子 is more colloquial.

examples.zh: 请把那把剪子给我。
examples.en: Please hand me that pair of scissors.

examples.zh: 这把剪子不快，剪不开纸。
examples.en: These scissors aren't sharp and can't cut the paper.

examples.zh: 你有剪子吗？我想剪这张纸。
examples.en: Do you have scissors? I want to cut this sheet of paper.

meaning: to give as a gift; to present

senses.en: to give as a gift; to present

note: Common in promotions: 赠送礼品.

examples.zh: 买两瓶牛奶，赠送一个杯子。
examples.en: Buy two bottles of milk and get a cup free.

examples.zh: 朋友赠送了我一本书。
examples.en: A friend gave me a book as a present.

examples.zh: 酒店会赠送早饭吗？
examples.en: Does the hotel include breakfast for free?

note: Counts generations: 一辈人; also in 长辈, 晚辈, 一辈子.

examples.zh: 我们家三辈人住在一起。
examples.en: Three generations of our family live together.

examples.zh: 他比我大一辈。
examples.en: He is one generation older than me.

examples.zh: 你们这辈人比我们幸福。
examples.en: Your generation is happier than ours.

note: Common: 挂门诊, 门诊部. Opposite is 住院.

examples.zh: 你先去门诊看看，不用住院。
examples.en: Go to the outpatient clinic first; you may not need to be admitted.

examples.zh: 这家医院的门诊几点上班？
examples.en: What time does this hospital's outpatient clinic open?

examples.zh: 我在门诊排了两个小时的队。
examples.en: I queued at the outpatient clinic for two hours.
